Clinical Precision for Brain & Mental Health

Precision that follows the patient.

LifeBack™ is a clinical-grade longitudinal care platform for brain and mental health — unifying multiple signals into one adaptive, clinician-reviewed view. It treats brain and mental health as spectral and comorbid, spanning mood, behavioural, psychotic, neurotic, and developmental conditions. Clinical decision authority always stays with the treating physician.

Why LifeBack™

Mental and brain health care needs more than a one-time diagnosis.

Clinical complexity is multidimensional

Symptoms overlap, comorbidities are common, and disease trajectories evolve over time. Precision requires a fuller view of the individual, the diagnosis, and the population context.

Continuity is as important as assessment

Many conditions require months or years of follow-up. Treatment response, functional recovery, remission, and relapse risk need to remain visible between clinical visits.

India needs population-relevant precision

Models, genomic risk, and treatment insights should reflect India's demographic, genetic, linguistic, and clinical diversity rather than depend only on external reference populations.

Scalable expertise

Extends specialist-level psychiatric care to underserved settings, so quality doesn't depend on geography.

Data-driven governance

Moves beyond subjective assessments to structured, clinician-led records that track outcomes and enable proactive intervention.

The Platform

Structured intelligence, always under clinician review.

LifeBack™ brings structured assessment, multimodal signal, and clinician review together into one workflow — supporting diagnostic consistency and longitudinal care while keeping clinical authority with the treating physician.

01 · INTAKE

Structured Assessment

Consented clinical context and relevant assessment inputs are brought into one structured patient record.

02 · SYNTHESIS

Multimodal Signal

Clinical, behavioural, and biological signal is organized into one structured summary for clinician review.

03 · RECORD

Clinician Review & Record

The treating physician reviews the evidence and records the clinical assessment, with additional specialist input available for complex cases.

Longitudinal tracking

Enables consistent monitoring of patient progress over time, not just isolated assessments.

Scalable consistency

Standardizes data capture across settings, reducing variability in diagnostic quality.

Specialist escalation

Flags complex cases for additional expert input without disrupting the primary workflow.

Governance principle: clinical decision authority remains with the treating physician at every stage. LifeBack™ supports clinical judgement; it does not replace it.

Public overview only. Workflow logic, model design, and implementation details are intentionally omitted while related intellectual property is under protection.
